# v1.0.0 — web quality audit of Practice Software Testing

First release.

- 43 Playwright tests, each run on the bug build and on the clean build: 86 runs, all as expected.
- 17 defects found on the bug build (6 major, 10 minor, 1 trivial), each pinned with `knownBug()` and written up
  in `docs/findings.md`; 2 of them are on the clean build too.
- Areas: functional, content, accessibility (axe-core, keyboard), SEO, responsive UI, speed, REST API.
- Test plan, test summary report and a guide with an interactive version on GitHub Pages.
